text.title: AI-Assisted Development: Failure Modes
text.summary: 7 known failure modes when wiring Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot into a team's daily flow. Each carries a detector (what to look for) and a repair (the corrective action).

failure-mode.description: AI everywhere, no map: every developer uses the assistant for whatever is under the cursor, including the auth module; nobody can say which task classes are AI-off.
failure-mode.detector: Record `inputs[]` has no tool-to-task map or no block-list; AI-assisted PRs touch auth, crypto, payments or migrations with a single reviewer.
failure-mode.repair: Write the tool-to-task map and the block-list into the record; require two reviewers on block-listed paths (`r-tool-to-task-map-written`, `r-security-critical-block-list`).

failure-mode.description: Confident insecure default: the assistant produced `verify=False`, a hard-coded IV or a missing ownership check in a block-listed area; the prompter, more confident than usual, merged it after one review.
failure-mode.detector: Security finding or incident traced to an AI-assisted PR in a block-listed path; the PR had fewer than two reviewers or the second reviewer was the prompter.
failure-mode.repair: Enforce the two-reviewer rule with a non-prompter reviewer on block-listed paths, or mark the area `ai-off` (`r-security-critical-block-list`, `r-ai-diff-reviewed-like-human-code`).

failure-mode.description: Prose prompt: "write tests for this" with no pattern file or output target; the assistant returns a different fixture style every session and half a page of explanation.
failure-mode.detector: Prompts lack Context with a named pattern file or Output with an exact path; generated files diverge from repo conventions; no tool context file in the repo or its commands are stale.
failure-mode.repair: Use the four-block template and maintain the tool context file with build, test and convention rules (`r-structured-prompt-four-blocks`, `r-repo-context-file-maintained`).

failure-mode.description: Secrets in the prompt: `.env` or a customer export was pasted "so the model knows the config"; production credentials are now in a third-party chat log.
failure-mode.detector: Credentials, keys or customer records in prompt history or tool context; no ignore file excluding secrets and data directories; tool data-retention terms not recorded.
failure-mode.repair: Rotate the exposed secrets, add the ignore file, record the retention check, and mark unknown-retention tools `ai-off` for proprietary code (`r-no-secrets-or-customer-data-in-prompts`).

failure-mode.description: Hallucinated package: the diff adds `pip install some-plausible-utils`; the name does not exist in the registry today and will be registered by someone else tomorrow.
failure-mode.detector: An AI-introduced import or dependency the reviewer cannot find in the registry at the pinned version; new dependency not listed in the PR description.
failure-mode.repair: Verify every introduced package, import and API signature against the registry and documentation before review; block merge on any unresolvable dependency (`r-verify-introduced-dependencies-and-apis`).

failure-mode.description: Tests that test nothing: the generated suite asserts that no exception was raised, mocks the unit under test, and passes green on a function that returns the wrong sign.
failure-mode.detector: Generated tests with no value assertions; the suite stays green when the function under test is deliberately broken; tests mirror the implementation line by line.
failure-mode.repair: Delete assertion-free tests, keep only those that fail when the function is broken (`r-ai-tests-must-assert-and-fail-when-broken`).

failure-mode.description: Churn nobody measures: AI-assisted PRs are reverted or rewritten within two weeks at a higher rate than others, but without the label nobody can see it and the map never tightens.
failure-mode.detector: No `ai-assisted` label on PRs; outcome review has no defect, revert or churn comparison; a review records worse AI-assisted numbers and changes nothing in the map.
failure-mode.repair: Label AI-assisted PRs, compare the three metrics at every cadence, and tighten the map whenever AI-assisted PRs are worse (`r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human`).
